notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 79-year-old female admitted for upper GI bleed. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.82, creatinine 0.72, hemoglobin 12.6, platelets 235, sodium 139, wbc 8.5; vitals dbp 69-74, heart_rate 76-81, map 88-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 125-130, spo2 96-98, temp 36.9-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: EGD: mild nonbleeding gastritis; Pantoprazole 80 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Acute blood loss anemia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.68, hemoglobin 12.6, platelets 232, sodium 139, wbc 8.1; vitals dbp 69-71, heart_rate 78-81, map 88-90, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 124-130, spo2 97-98, temp 37-37.1
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Acute blood loss anemia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 79-year-old female, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Upper GI bleed. Acute blood loss anemia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
